en.ui.ipados.projection.geometry_help: Tap curves in the overview or select them in this list. All geometry includes curves and standalone points.
en.ui.ipados.projection.options_help: Construction creates guides that do not form profiles. Link to source keeps references updated when the source changes; turn it off to create independent geometry. Use Break Link later to detach a reference.
en.ui.ipados.projection.source_help: Choose a sketch earlier in the feature timeline. Geometry is projected onto the active sketch plane.
en.ui.ipados.projection.source_missing: The source sketch or selected geometry is no longer available. Reopen Project / Reference Geometry.
en.ui.ipados.projection.stale: The design changed. Reopen Project / Reference Geometry to use the current sketch.
en.ui.ipados.projection.title: Project / Reference Geometry
